CommunityApplications.Profile: SeerrNG is a Seerr fork for requests across movies, TV, music, books, comics, magazines, ROMs, and PC games. This repository publishes only the standalone SeerrNG Community Applications template. BookshelfNG, ROMarrNG, and QuestarrNG are optional standalone NG forks with templates in their own repositories. LazyLibrarian, Mylar3, and Kapowarr are third-party apps available through their existing Community Applications listings. Install only the services you use.
